breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the user's prompt specified a counterflow heat exchanger but provided the temperature difference formulas for a parallel-flow configuration. The agent corrected this by defining ΔT1 and ΔT2 using the proper counterflow convention (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in), which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
